target.title: fix(android): drain gateway events before disconnect callback
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an Android reconnect race where the runtime cleared microphone and conversation state in `onDisconnected` before the old Gateway message pump had finished processing already accepted frames.

## Why This Change Was Made

The terminal disconnect callback now waits for the message pump and any accepted connect handshake to drain. This preserves the issued-token safety boundary and gives consumers one coherent terminal point. The native i18n inventory is refreshed solely for the two shifted source locations required by the native CI gate.

## User Impact

Voice and chat consumers do not discard a just-arrived final event merely because the WebSocket close callback raced ahead of the inbound message pump.

## Evidence

- Tightened the existing reconnect regression to prove the terminal callback stays pending while an accepted frame blocks, then completes after the frame and issued-token handshake drain.
- `./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionReconnectTest` passed: BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
- `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed after refreshing the two affected source-location entries.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- AI-assisted; two repository autoreview passes completed with no accepted findings.
